Specification: This module is a collection of tests for an Option abstraction and related helper operators, rather than a distributed protocol or transition system. It defines a helper operator MaxSet that folds over a set to compute its maximum as an optional value, and then specifies a conjunction of test predicates covering mapping, case analysis, conversion to sequences and sets, flatMap, guessing from a set, function application on optional arguments, and creation of partial functions returning options. The module uses a trivial behavior structure with Init asserting all tests and Next == TRUE, and it does not include fairness, fault modeling, or liveness properties beyond these state-level test assertions.
